items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: I introduced her to Emilia at Code 38

ctx.x: Yeah, she was completely revived that night, 1976. But, and then, when we left, after we came out of the, you know, I introduced her to Emilia at Code 38, because she came over there, and he wanted to know who she was. I said, that's what Irma doing. He said, ma'am, introduce me to her. I said, okay, we're until intermission. And I introduced her the next Sunday. I didn't see her until the next Sunday. She came there with him. And I, he mattered. What she said, she was never really successful until he got in her…
